prefix: Create a clean technical color atlas using this reference as character identity. Exactly four strict orthographic views of the SAME object in ONE wide row, each entirely within its own quarter with large white gutters. Left to right TOP (camera directly above, front pointing to page bottom), LEFT (camera horizontal, snout/front toward screen LEFT), FRONT straight on, REAR straight behind. Identical pose, same pixels per unit, common floor line across elevations. Soft matte pink molded toy material. Pure uniform white background; no text, outlines, floor, contact shadows, perspective or props.

parts.whole: The full little pink piglet from the center of the source, as a standing character. Same short stocky legs, chocolate cloven hooves, large broad bulbous head, glossy dark oval eyes, coral snout with two nostrils, and the two big rounded ears FLOPPING forwards and slightly outwards at their tips, a small gap under each folded flap. Side view clearly shows curled little pigtail on rump. Keep believable identical anatomy across views. Ignore cropped portions of other farm animals.
parts.ear: Show ONLY ONE DETACHED LEFT pig ear from this piglet in a deliberately UNFOLDED neutral rigging rest pose. ONE layer of flexible pale pink flesh, like a broad floppy rounded triangular leaf held perfectly upright, root below, free rounded tip at the very top; no existing downward bend, no doubled or folded flap, no creases crossing the tip. Attachment root at the bottom moderately broad, widest across the middle, rounded taper to a single soft upper tip. Front view shows its broad gently cupped pink face with subtle salmon-colored inside. Rear broad with smooth pale back. TOP and LEFT correspond to the narrow thickness of the same upright leaf (width:height:depth about .80:1:.23), softly bowed bowl in depth; no head, no other ear, no eyes, no pig. The ear must be OPEN in all four views, with the leaf blade never folding back over itself. The reference photo shows its desired FUTURE posed state only.
parts.head: ONLY the large isolated smooth blank piglet HEAD SHELL from the center of the reference. Rounded broad domed forehead, softly bulging widening cheeks and low broadly round jaw, width:height about 1.35:1. A single seamless pink organic shape. Remove ears completely (smooth attachment areas), remove snout completely (smooth uninterrupted face where it attaches), exclude eyes/markings, neck, body, tail and legs. All four views of this SAME detached head only.
parts.torso: ONLY the detached rounded pink TORSO of the piglet, belly and rump in neutral standing orientation, seamless smooth torso with rounded ends and soft plump belly. Remove head, ALL legs and hooves, ears, tail, markings and eyes. TOP is the horizontal back, LEFT side has the neck end to the left and rump to the right. Only smooth single torso.
parts.snout: ONLY the detached coral pink pig SNOUT, a blunt thick oval pad broader than tall with two distinct dark recessed vertical oval nostrils side by side in FRONT. Shallow dented sockets, flat rear mounting face without holes, a rounded blunt upper edge. No head, lips, mouth, ears or eyes. TOP shows depth extending forward, front at page bottom; LEFT shows short depth, front facing left.
parts.leg: ONLY ONE detached short stocky pink piglet leg including ONE dark chocolate split hoof, with two rounded cloven toes inside the same hoof. Plain unseen rounded top end for insertion into body, level sole. Only the one leg standing upright, no torso, no other legs. Broad soft pink upper cylinder narrowing toward dark hoof. TOP sees pink stump; LEFT points toes left; FRONT shows cleft.
parts.tail: ONLY the detached curly piglet tail, a smooth pink tapered round tube that curls through just over one turn as a small open spiral, prominent WHITE daylight in the circular center and a separate tapered free end. Show exactly the same tail in each view. Spiral lies mainly in the sagittal YZ plane, viewed broadside in LEFT panel where its eye is clearly visible. TOP, FRONT and REAR see the curl more edge-on as expected. Root attaches to rear of pig (front points left in LEFT panel), with a small stalk from the left into the coil. No pig, rump, body, ears or face.
